class.name: FlowConnection
class.brief_description: A read-only view of one connection of a [FlowGraph].
class.description: A [FlowConnection] names the two ends of a connection: the output port of one node and the input port of another node. The graph creates these objects on demand in [method FlowGraph.get_connections], [method FlowGraph.get_output_connections] and [method FlowGraph.get_input_connections]. They are snapshots: changing one is not possible, and a later change of the graph is not reflected in an object you already hold. Create connections with [method FlowGraph.connect_nodes] and remove them with [method FlowGraph.disconnect_nodes]. [codeblocks] [gdscript] for connection in graph.get_output_connections(node_id): print("%d.%s -> %d.%s" % [connection.from_node_id, connection.from_port, connection.to_node_id, connection.to_port]) [/gdscript] [csharp] foreach (FlowConnection connection in graph.GetOutputConnections(nodeId)) { GD.Print($"{connection.FromNodeId}.{connection.FromPort} -> {connection.ToNodeId}.{connection.ToPort}"); } [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

members.member: The id of the node whose output port is the source of the connection.
The name of the output port on the source node.
Whether the connection carries the execution ([constant FlowPort.PORT_KIND_FLOW]) or a value ([constant FlowPort.PORT_KIND_DATA]). It is the kind of the source port.
The id of the node whose input port is the target of the connection.
The name of the input port on the target node.
